facts.business: Vardhman Special Steels Limited manufactures special steel bars and billets for automotive and engineering applications, with capabilities in precision rolling, heat treatment, and digital manufacturing integration.

capacity_or_capex.item: Rolling Mill capacity expansion to 270,000 tonnes per annum

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Kocks block reached full operation faster than the schedule asked. Stabilised within the year, it reset what the rolling mill could promise.
On 1 July 2025, the Company moved to SAP S/4HANA. The migration consolidated planning, finance, production, costing, maintenance and quality into a single platform.
The successful commissioning of the walking-beam Reheating Furnace in the fourth quarter has increased the Rolling Mill's capacity to 270,000 tonnes per annum.

facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions entered into by the Company during the financial year with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. The Company had not entered into any contract/arrangement/transaction with related parties which could be considered material in accordance with Regulation 23 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
